events.text: The buyer is still within the 30-day return window, delivery was Oct 12 so the window runs until Nov 11. Since the listing misrepresented the item, policy entitles them to a full refund without paying return shipping, but I need to figure out whether "full refund" covers just the item price or the entire $166 including the $24 shipping charge.

input.headline: Colour complaint, item as listed. Offer a full refund on return, as the 30-day policy allows
input.summary: Oliver received the Tan Market Tote on 12 Oct and says it is darker and browner than the photos. The listing and Terms of Sale both warn that hide tone varies and that photos are taken in daylight, so the tote is not defective. The buyer is still inside the 30-day return window, though, and a SNAD claim usually ends in a refund with a return anyway. The cheapest fair outcome is to offer a refund with return now, at the inquiry stage. This follows the published policy, and the buyer pays return shipping because he is an international buyer.

reasoning.point: The listing states that tone varies from hide to hide and deepens with use, and that photos are taken in daylight. The Terms of Sale, accepted at checkout, say these variations are not defects.
DHL Express delivered on 12 Oct to the transaction address, so delivery is not in question. Only the colour is disputed.

The returns policy gives a full refund for unused items returned within 30 days of delivery (until 11 Nov). International buyers pay return shipping unless the item is defective. A refund with return is exactly what the merchant already promised.
The buyer contacted the store first, calls the tote 'lovely', and has no prior disputes. The merchant already offered a partial refund or a return. This is an unhappy customer, not a bad-faith one.
Colour SNAD claims that escalate usually end with PayPal ordering a refund on return anyway. Fighting now risks the fee and a mark against the seller without saving the sale.

risks: The buyer may reject the offer because he has to pay return postage from the UK, and escalate to a claim. The claim would most likely still end in a refund with return.
If the tote comes back used or damaged, the policy's 'unused, original condition' term applies. Inspect it on arrival before refunding.
The offer refunds the full $166 including outbound shipping. The merchant could limit it to the $142 item price, but that is more likely to cause friction and escalation.
missing_evidence: The buyer's photo of the tote he received, to compare with the hide variation swatches in the listing
Studio photo or record of the specific hide used for this tote before it shipped

input.response_letter:
Kora Atelier sent the Market Tote in Tan exactly as listed. We are happy to give a full refund of USD 166.00 once the unused tote is returned, under our 30-day returns policy.

The listing (Exhibit A) states that the tote is full-grain vegetable-tanned leather. It also says that tone varies from hide to hide, deepens with use, and is photographed in daylight. It shows hide variation swatches as well. Our Terms of Sale (Exhibit B), accepted at checkout on 7 Oct 2026, explain that natural variations in tone are not defects.

DHL Express delivered the order to the buyer's address at 14 Albion Road, London N16 9PH on 12 Oct 2026 (Exhibit D). The buyer emailed us on 13 Oct about the shade. We replied the next day and offered either a partial refund or a return (Exhibit E).

Our Returns policy (Exhibit C) gives a full refund for unused items returned within 30 days of delivery. International buyers cover return shipping unless the item is defective. The buyer is within that window, so we are offering a full refund of USD 166.00 when the tote arrives back at our studio in Brooklyn, NY, unused and in its original condition. We will issue the refund within 3 business days of receiving it.

buyer_message.text:
Hi Oliver,

Thanks again for letting us know about the tote. Every Market Tote is cut from a different vegetable-tanned hide, so some come out a deeper, warmer shade than the one in our daylight photos. We're sorry this one isn't the tan you were hoping for.

We've sent you an offer through PayPal: a full refund of USD 166.00 once the tote is back with us. It needs to be unused, in its original condition, and posted by 11 November. Please send it to our Brooklyn studio with a tracked service and reply with the tracking number. As set out in our returns policy, return postage from the UK is at your cost. We'll refund you within 3 business days of it arriving.

If you'd rather keep it, our earlier offer of a partial refund still stands. Just let us know.

Warmly,
Kora Atelier
